title: fix(plugin-approvals): refuse an inverted delegation window and a self-delegation at the write
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DU5CHkeh2msc49m4dh6kwEt)_
Fixes #33062
Area-lease pilot #33059, area A3.

## What changes

`sys_approval_delegation` declares two `validations` (same shape as `sys_user_permission_set.validity_window_order`):

- `validity_window_order` (cross_field, attaches to `valid_until`): refused when both bounds are set and `valid_until <= valid_from` (compared as instants with `datetime()`).
- `delegate_not_delegator` (cross_field, attaches to `delegate_id`): refused when `delegate_id == delegator_id`.

Each rule is judged on insert (`previous == null`) and on an update that moves one of its two columns, against the stored row overlaid with the patch. Validation runs after `beforeInsert`, so a delegator stamped by `bindDelegationWriteGuard` is judged too. Also: i18n bundles regenerated (zh-CN translated), one paragraph in `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx`, a patch changeset. `approval-service.ts` and `sys-approval-action.object.ts` are untouched.

## Why

Both shapes used to be stored with `201` and then never rerouted an approval (`isGrantActive` drops an inverted window; a self-delegate moves nothing), so the delegator believed their approvals were covered. Contract-first: refuse at the write instead of tolerating at resolution.

Stored rows with either shape (from before this change) stay inert as before and keep taking unrelated edits; the remedy is to correct the dates or the delegate, or delete the row.

## Verification

New `sys-approval-delegation-inert-shapes.integration.test.ts` (real `ObjectQL` + `SqlDriver`, write guard bound), 12 cases: inverted window and self-delegation refused for the delegator and a system writer (`400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, field + `rule_violation`, the rule's own message, no row stored); equal bounds refused; self-delegation via the guard's stamp refused; updates that invert the window or set the delegate to the delegator refused with the row unchanged; CONTROLs: valid window + different delegate lands, open-ended windows (either bound, or none) land, moving a bound within a valid window lands, a legacy inert row takes an unrelated edit and can be repaired.

<details><summary>Ablation (also the premise check): object file reverted to origin/main at 4e6f7a59</summary>

```
before mutation: delegate_not_delegator=1 validity_window_order=2
after mutation (origin/main object): delegate_not_delegator=0 validity_window_order=0
     × NEGATIVE — the delegator: valid_until before valid_from is refused 400 on valid_until; nothing is stored
     × NEGATIVE — the delegator: the delegator as their own delegate is refused 400 on delegate_id; nothing is stored
     × NEGATIVE — a system writer: valid_until before valid_from is refused 400 on valid_until; nothing is stored
     × NEGATIVE — a system writer: the delegator as their own delegate is refused 400 on delegate_id; nothing is stored
     × NEGATIVE — equal bounds are refused: a window from t until t is empty
     × NEGATIVE — a self-delegation that leaves the delegator to the write guard's stamp is refused
     × NEGATIVE — moving valid_until to before the stored valid_from is refused; the row is unchanged
     × NEGATIVE — changing the delegate to the delegator is refused; the row is unchanged
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  8 failed | 4 passed (12)
restored: hash d1c64ad40c34796e7546d4bfacc52537749ce7b6 == HEAD blob; git diff HEAD lines: 0
```

Every red case failed with "expected the write to be refused, but it succeeded": on origin/main all eight writes land.
</details>
